releases.name: Radiant Royal Giant
releases.headline: Meet Radiant Royal Giant — Drop's first named release
notes: Drop has its first named release: Radiant Royal Giant.

What began as a quick way to drill card costs is now a full game with six ways to play: Surge, Practice, Higher / Lower, Trade, Survival, and Rain. Sign in with a magic link to keep your progress, earn Player XP, climb a 28-arena journey, chase season bests, and see how your ranked runs stack up.

This release also brings a cleaner mobile and desktop experience, install support for your phone, keyboard controls on desktop, easier score sharing, and a long list of gameplay fixes and polish. Practice stays unranked and focused on learning; the other modes are ready when you want to race the board.
And if you need a quieter moment after the sprint, there is a card-rain screensaver hiding in plain sight.
Come give Radiant Royal Giant a run — and see which elixir cost still catches you.
